name: c64-resurrect
description: Repair OCR misreads in scanned 1984 Commodore 64 type-in listings on a real C64 emulator, through a checksum gate that refuses any edit the magazine's own printed :rem checksum does not allow. Packages the petscii-notation skill and the BASIC V2 error guide; it also declares the repo's c64 MCP server (6 tools), which failed to connect when installed as a Power in kiro-cli 3.6.0 (see README.md), so the server runs from the repo's own .kiro/settings/mcp.json.
